orderControl.title: Order control
orderControl.description: Find floor work, resolve exceptions, and move eligible queued orders. {{asOf}}
orderControl.summaryUnavailable: Order attention could not be refreshed.
orderControl.emptyFiltered: Clear a filter or search for a different order.
orderControl.empty: New order work will appear here as the floor changes.
orderControl.attentionIntakeDetail: Record this order's bag count before it can be scheduled for production.
orderControl.attentionPlacementPendingDetail: This eligible order is not assigned to a production batch. Review the active run and place it before floor work begins.
orderControl.attentionPlacementConflictDetail: The production queue changed before placement completed. Refresh, then review the order's current position before placing it again.
orderControl.attentionRouteBlockedDetail: LPMS cannot find a compatible route through the order's remaining stages. Review its physical restart stage and later batch capacity.

errors.loadFailed: Orders could not be refreshed. Current results may be outdated; check your connection and refresh.
errors.targetsFailed: Destination batches could not be loaded. Close this action and reopen the order before choosing a batch.
errors.previewFailed: LPMS could not verify a safe destination. No floor change was submitted.
errors.commitUnknown: LPMS could not confirm the result. Refresh and verify the order's current batch before trying again.
errors.conflict: This order or its batch changed while the action was open. Reopen the order and review its current floor position.
errors.hardCapacity: No later compatible batch has enough hard capacity for this whole order at the selected restart stage. Free capacity in a later batch or keep the order with its current batch.
errors.noLaterTarget: This run has no later batch that can receive the order. Keep it with the current batch or plan the remaining work in a new run.
errors.noFeasibleTarget: No later batch can carry this whole order through every remaining required stage. Review the restart stage and later batch capacity.
errors.orderUnavailable: This order is no longer available in Order control. Refresh the order list.
errors.orderNotScheduled: This order is no longer assigned to the active production run. Refresh before taking floor action.
errors.sourceBatchEmpty: Moving this order would leave its current batch empty. Keep it there or rebuild the production plan.
errors.weightInvalid: This order does not have a valid production weight, so LPMS cannot verify hard capacity.
errors.queuedSourceRequired: A normal move requires the current batch to be queued and mutable. Use a floor exception only after the batch starts.
errors.inFlightSourceRequired: Leave-behind and rework are available only after the current batch starts.
errors.stageChanged: The order's current floor stage changed. Close this action, reopen the order, and choose the physical restart stage again.
errors.restartSkipsWork: The selected restart stage would skip unfinished work. Choose the earliest stage that still needs to be completed.
errors.targetIncompatible: The proposed batch no longer contains every stage this order needs. Review the order again for a compatible batch.
errors.proposalStale: This preview expired because the production record changed. Review the order again before confirming.
errors.runClosed: This production run is closed, so its order routing can no longer be changed.
errors.unauthorized: Your session expired. Sign in again before continuing.
errors.forbidden: Your account cannot move or reroute this order. Ask an owner or administrator to complete the action.
errors.unavailable: Order control cannot reach the production service. Check your connection and refresh.
errors.invalidResponse: The production service returned order data that Processor could not read. Refresh before continuing.

orderControl.unassignedDetail: This order is not currently assigned to a production batch.
orderControl.membershipFrozen: Membership is frozen against normal queue changes.
orderControl.membershipMutable: Membership is still mutable while this batch remains queued.
orderControl.moveUnavailable: Normal moves require a mutable queued source batch.
orderControl.leaveUnavailable: Leave-behind is available after the source batch starts.
orderControl.reworkUnavailable: Rework is available after the source batch starts.

commandDenied.orderNotFound: This order is no longer available for a floor route.
commandDenied.runNotStarted: Floor routing is available after the production run starts.
commandDenied.orderResolved: This order has left active production work.
commandDenied.resolutionStateInvalid: This order's current resolution state does not allow floor routing.
commandDenied.executionStateInvalid: This order's current production state does not allow this floor change.
commandDenied.orderNotScheduled: This order is not assigned to the active production run.
commandDenied.sourceBatchWouldBeEmpty: Moving this order would leave its current batch empty.
commandDenied.orderWeightInvalid: This order does not have a valid production weight for capacity checks.
commandDenied.sourceBatchInvalid: The order's current batch is no longer a valid routing source.
commandDenied.sourceNotQueued: A normal move requires the current batch to still be queued.
commandDenied.sourceFrozen: The current batch has frozen membership and cannot be changed normally.
commandDenied.sourceNotInFlight: Leave-behind and rework are available only after the current batch starts.
commandDenied.sourceStageMismatch: The order's recorded floor stage changed; reopen it before routing.
commandDenied.restartSkipsWork: The selected restart stage would skip unfinished work.
commandDenied.targetStageGraphInvalid: No destination has every remaining stage this order requires.
commandDenied.noLaterTarget: This run has no later batch that can receive the order.
commandDenied.noFeasibleTarget: No later batch can carry the whole order through its remaining work.
commandDenied.hardCapacityExceeded: No compatible batch has enough hard capacity for this whole order.

targetDenied.currentBatch: This is the order's current batch.
targetDenied.stageGraphInvalid: This batch does not contain every remaining required stage.
targetDenied.stageNotPlanned: This batch does not have the required stage planned.
targetDenied.hardCapacityExceeded: This whole order would exceed the batch's hard capacity.

orderControl.destinationDetail: {{weight, number}} of {{capacity, number}} lb after this whole order moves.
orderControl.keepTogether: Keep every bag in the customer order together and retain completed attempt history.
orderControl.irreversible: This records physical floor truth and cannot be silently undone.
orderControl.batchImmutable: This batch has started or its membership is frozen.
orderControl.exceedsCapacity: The whole order would exceed hard pulse capacity.
orderControl.noTarget: No mutable queued batch can receive this whole order.
orderControl.queuedOnlyDescription: LPMS will keep the order whole, enforce hard pulse capacity, and record the manual placement. In-flight batches are not normal move targets.
orderControl.leaveDescription: Record that this order cannot continue with its current batch and choose where production must resume.
orderControl.reworkDescription: Record the repeated production stage and review the later batch that can safely carry the work.
orderControl.physicalTruth: Choose physical truth, not the stage LPMS currently expects.
orderControl.nextCompatibleDescription: LPMS will preview the earliest later batch that can carry the whole order through every required stage without exceeding hard capacity.
orderControl.notePlaceholder: What should the next employee know?
orderControl.otherNoteRequired: Add a short floor note when the reason is Other.
orderControl.archiveKeepsHistory: This does not delete or complete the order
orderControl.archiveKeepsHistoryDetail: Pressly removes the order from current floor work, keeps a permanent audit record, and allows an owner or administrator to restore it from History.
orderControl.archiveReason: Why should this leave active work?
orderControl.archiveNotePlaceholder: Add context for the permanent audit record
orderControl.archiveFactsConfirmed: I reviewed these Pressly facts and confirmed this order should leave active work.
orderControl.archiveReviewAdmission: A manager manually released this order.
orderControl.archiveReviewPlacement: This order has a pending production placement.
orderControl.archiveBlockedExecution: Production has already committed execution for this order.
orderControl.archiveBlockedSelection: This order has been selected for a production shift.
orderControl.archiveBlockedBatch: This order has production batch history.
orderControl.archiveBlockedStage: This order has recorded stage work.
orderControl.archiveBlockedRoute: This order has recorded floor routing.
orderControl.archiveBlockedState: The current Pressly lifecycle does not allow archiving.
orderControl.confirmArchiveDetail: {{customer}} will leave active floor work. The order remains in History and can be restored.

manageOrders.incomingDescription: Review orders reported by connected sources. Add one only when it belongs in Pressly.
manageOrders.sourceClosedCompleted: {{source}} reported this order completed before it was added to Pressly. No Pressly order was created.
manageOrders.sourceClosedCanceled: {{source}} reported this order canceled before it was added to Pressly. No Pressly order was created.
manageOrders.acceptDescription: Pressly will create this as an unreleased, forecast-only order. It will not enter Needs intake or Production until you explicitly release it. Later source updates cannot change it.
manageOrders.rejectDescription: The proposal will close without creating an order or production work in Pressly.
manageOrders.restoreDescription: Return this candidate to Needs review. Later source closure updates will not close it again. No Pressly order is created until you add it.
manageOrders.rejectReason: Why are you rejecting this order?
manageOrders.rejectReasonRequired: Choose a reason before rejecting this order.

acceptBlocked.exactOrderExists: Already in Pressly. Reject this duplicate proposal to close it.

manageOrders.accepted: Order {{order}} was added to Pressly as unreleased work.
manageOrders.rejected: Order {{order}} was rejected. No Pressly order was created.
manageOrders.restored: Order {{order}} was restored to Needs review.

conflicts.stale: This reported order changed while you were reviewing it. The list has been refreshed.
conflicts.decided: This reported order was already changed. The list has been refreshed.
conflicts.existing: This order already exists in Pressly. Reject the duplicate candidate if it should leave Needs review.
conflicts.generic: This reported order changed before the decision completed. The list has been refreshed.

manageOrders.emptyDescription: New submitted orders will appear here before they enter Pressly.
manageOrders.sourceClosedEmptyDescription: Orders that Cents closes before Pressly accepts them will remain available here for review.

errors.title: Reported orders need attention
errors.load: Reported orders could not be loaded. Check the connection and refresh.
errors.mutation: Pressly could not confirm this decision. Review the candidate and try again.
errors.forbidden: Your account cannot accept, reject, or restore reported orders. Ask an owner or administrator.
errors.unauthorized: Your session expired. Sign in again before reviewing reported orders.
errors.unavailable: Reported orders cannot reach the order service. Check the connection and try again.
errors.invalidResponse: The order service returned data that Processor could not read. Refresh before continuing.
